literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 乙型肝炎知晓率汇总为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%),乌干达中部和医护人员的知晓率明显高于其他地区和群体。 [paper-2fedcc97b9dc78ee]
然而,其临床应用因显着的细胞毒性、诱导细胞凋亡、半衰期短和体内不良反应而受到严重限制。 [paper-2189495d0f9c5a69]
IL-17F 主要由 CD4+ T 细胞在 HBcAg 刺激后分泌,并在功能上促进纤维化相关细胞因子和标志物的表达。 [paper-fdbe5860b11012f0]
TDF 与小风险的肾毒性和骨毒性相关,主要发生在老年和高风险患者中。 [paper-66619f3ed7138565]

血清学确诊的抗-HBs阳性率为51.10%(1,208/2,364),远低于世界卫生组织建议的70%阈值。空间分析显示,地理异质性显着(χ2 = 74.38,P < 0.001),免疫力较高的地区集中在规模较大的工业带(67.33%),免疫力较低的地区集中在分散的服务业区(36.81%)。SEM 结果表明,虽然外部线索强烈预测 HBV 知识(β = 0.894),但知识对预防意图(β = 0.192)只有边际影响,而预防意图又显着预测实际行为(β = 0.655)。 [paper-eb67546d253ee1df]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%), and awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda and among healthcare workers compared to other regions and groups. [paper-2fedcc97b9dc78ee]
However, its clinical application is severely limited by significant cytotoxicity, the induction of apoptosis, a short half-life, and adverse in vivo effects. [paper-2189495d0f9c5a69]
IL-17F was primarily secreted by CD4+ T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. [paper-fdbe5860b11012f0]
TDF is associated with a small risk renal and bone toxicity, primarily in older and higher risk patients. [paper-66619f3ed7138565]
The serologically confirmed anti-HBs positive rate was 51.10% (1,208/2,364), substantially lower than the 70% threshold recommended by the World Health Organization. [paper-eb67546d253ee1df]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻资格由来源、日期、正文身份和相关性终审决定；中文翻译状态不影响有效新闻的保留。中文字段不可用时，本区域使用已核验英文内容填充。
key_findings_zh: 周六,一场控制和消除乙型肝炎的健康运动在北京举行。公共卫生官员和临床医生聚集在一起评估进展并制定后续步骤。该活动是一项公众意识和政策实施举措,而不是疫情报告。 [news-a1912f67bec17f0e]
由北京佑安医院任峰教授领导的研究团队在《医学病毒学杂志》上发表了一篇论文,利用CRISPR-Cas13a/Cas12a和RT-RAA技术,建立了一种用于检测丙型肝炎病毒(HDV)RNA和乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)DNA的新型双便携可视化检测方法。 [news-36e9f5f5bef36153]
发表在《基因与疾病》杂志上的一项研究调查了乙型肝炎病毒引起的肝脏炎症的分子机制。该研究发现了活性氧 (ROS) 依赖性信号级联激活 Jak2/Stat3 通路。 [news-83282bd15d14e9e8]
ETSU 研究人员寻求乙型肝炎治愈方法 - 东田纳西州立大学。 [news-fc07d105b6e41b89]
内伦敦北区的助理验尸官理查德·布里顿 (Richard Brittain) 在 41 岁的患者 Tung Tran 先生因无意中停用恩替卡韦 (N3、N9) 引起乙型肝炎再激活并发症而死亡后,发布了一份“预防未来死亡”报告。 [news-f793842f22e55422]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.caveats_zh: 中文翻译不完整时会以英文证据填充中文显示位置，并在后台记录translation_status=english_fallback。
news.lead_en: News eligibility is determined by source, date, body identity and final relevance. Translation completeness does not determine whether an eligible report is retained.
key_findings_en: A health campaign to control and eliminate hepatitis B was held in Beijing on a Saturday. Public health officials and clinicians gathered to assess progress and map out next steps. The event is a public awareness and policy implementation initiative, not an outbreak report. [news-a1912f67bec17f0e]

A research team led by Professor Ren Feng from Beijing You'an Hospital published a paper in the *Journal of Medical Virology* establishing a novel dual portable and visualized detection method for Hepatitis D Virus (HDV) RNA and Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) DNA using CRISPR-Cas13a/Cas12a and RT-RAA technologies. [news-36e9f5f5bef36153]

A study published in Genes & Diseases investigated the molecular mechanisms underlying HBV-induced liver inflammation. The research identified a reactive oxygen species (ROS)-dependent signaling cascade activating the Jak2/Stat3 pathway. [news-83282bd15d14e9e8]
ETSU researcher seeks Hepatitis B cure - East Tennessee State University. [news-fc07d105b6e41b89]

An assistant coroner for Inner London North, Richard Brittain, issued a 'Prevention of Future Deaths' report following the death of a patient, Mr. Tung Tran, aged 41, due to complications from hepatitis B reactivation caused by the inadvertent discontinuation of entecavir (N3, N9). [news-f793842f22e55422]

papers.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管有有效的治疗和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和艾滋病毒仍然是公共卫生挑战。感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例、进一步传播以及可预防的发病率和死亡率。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群,有许多感染未被发现。我们使用来自三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的 14,444 名 15-79 岁参与者的数据估计了 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率,确定了决定因素并评估了 20 年来的趋势。参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的调查问卷,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的血清样本进行了 HBV 和 HCV 检测以及 HIV 检测。血清阳性率估计值根据荷兰人群进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。加权 HBV 血清阳性率在各项调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在的感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染)。第一代流动人口中乙型肝炎病毒感染率最高,年龄、流动背景和性传播感染史是关键决定因素。HCV 血清流行率仍然较低(< 0.4%),并且在非西方移民中最高。艾滋病毒感染率为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中感染率最高。只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。总体而言,荷兰的 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认识有限的特定群体。这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。

papers.title: Reviewing hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related mortality in Birmingham (2018-2023): The impact of late diagnosis.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Review hepatitis B (HBV)-related deaths in Birmingham to interrogate higher HBV-related mortality rates, understand causes of death and identify areas for improvement in diagnostic and care pathways to reduce preventable deaths. STUDY DESIGN: Enhanced surveillance - retrospective review of deaths, with linkage to Office for National Statistics (ONS) mortality database for validation. METHODS: Clinicians submitted data on HBV-related deaths occurring in Birmingham (2018-2023) among adults attending for specialist care in the city. Cause of death was obtained from hospital records linked to ONS data. RESULTS: Data were submitted on 44 people who died of HBV-related causes; 86% were male. Eighty percent were non-UK-born; 70% were born in countries with intermediate-high HBV prevalence. The majority likely acquired HBV in early life (83%). Median age at HBV diagnosis in the UK was 52 years (interquartile range (IQR): 39-62 years); 72% had cirrhosis at diagnosis. The most common diagnosis setting was secondary care (70%). Median age at death was 59 years (IQR: 46-72 years); the most common causes were liver cancer (50%; n = 22) and end-stage liver disease (23%; n = 10). CONCLUSIONS: Among those dying of HBV-related causes in Birmingham, there were missed opportunities for earlier diagnosis, particularly in primary care. The majority of people who died were migrants and probably acquired HBV in early life, yet most were diagnosed in secondary care, middle-aged and with advanced disease. To achieve public health targets around HBV mortality, testing offer/uptake and linkage to care must be improved, addressing barriers and awareness among at-risk groups and healthcare professionals.

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:回顾伯明翰与乙型肝炎 (HBV) 相关的死亡情况,了解较高的 HBV 相关死亡率,了解死亡原因,并确定诊断和护理途径中需要改进的领域,以减少可预防的死亡。研究设计:加强监测——对死亡情况进行回顾性审查,并与国家统计局 (ONS) 死亡率数据库联系起来进行验证。方法:临床医生提交了伯明翰(2018-2023 年)在该市接受专科护理的成年人中发生的 HBV 相关死亡数据。死亡原因是从与国家统计局数据相关的医院记录中获得的。结果:提交了 44 名死于 HBV 相关原因的患者的数据;86%为男性。百分之八十不是英国出生的;70% 出生在乙型肝炎病毒中高流行率的国家。大多数人可能在早年感染乙肝病毒(83%)。英国诊断 HBV 的中位年龄为 52 岁(四分位距 (IQR):39-62 岁);72% 在诊断时患有肝硬化。最常见的诊断环境是二级护理(70%)。死亡中位年龄为 59 岁(IQR:46-72 岁);最常见的原因是肝癌(50%;n = 22)和终末期肝病(23%;n = 10)。结论:在伯明翰死于乙型肝炎相关原因的患者中,错过了早期诊断的机会,特别是在初级保健中。大多数死亡者是移民,可能在早年感染了乙型肝炎病毒,但大多数人是在二级保健机构被诊断为中年和晚期疾病。为了实现围绕乙型肝炎死亡率的公共卫生目标,必须改进检测的提供/采用以及与护理的联系,解决高危人群和医疗保健专业人员的障碍和认识。

papers.title: Serum M2BPGi as a predictor of hepatocellular carcinoma development in chronic hepatitis B and C: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) kills about 830,000 people each year, and most cases arise in chronic viral hepatitis. Better risk markers would let clinicians focus surveillance where it matters. Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) is a serum glycobiomarker of liver fibrosis. Several cohort studies tie elevated M2BPGi to HCC. No quantitative synthesis has pooled this evidence across viral etiologies. Methods We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies that reported hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). We registered the protocol with PROSPERO. The primary pool restricted to longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs that reported HRs. We used random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment. Results Twenty-three publications (24 study entries) met inclusion criteria. The primary pool of 15 longitudinal categorical HR-reporting studies covered 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. The pooled HR was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I 2 = 25.6%). The 95% prediction interval ran from 2.08 to 10.18. The effect held across etiology (CHB k = 5 HR 4.12; HCV k = 10 HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and across measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Two sensitivity pools re-introducing OR-based studies gave HR 4.71 ( k = 16) and HR 4.89 ( k = 17). Egger’s test was positive ( p = 0.0003); trim-and-fill imputed six studies and pulled the adjusted HR to 3.53. Conclusion Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C. The effect holds across etiology, treatment status, and measurement timing–including after sustained virological response. Funnel asymmetry suggests the true effect is closer to a 3.5-fold than a 4.6-fold risk increase, still large enough to matter clinically. M2BPGi is a credible candidate to layer onto current viral hepatitis surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372566 , identifier CRD420261372566.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the association between elevated serum Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) levels and the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). The central question is whether M2BPGi can serve as a predictor of HCC development in these populations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies reporting hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in CHB or HCV. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO. The primary pool included 15 longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs reporting HRs, covering 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. Random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment was used. [A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11].
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled hazard ratio (HR) for HCC development in patients with elevated M2BPGi was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I2 = 25.6%). The effect was consistent across etiology (CHB HR 4.12; HCV HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Sensitivity analyses re-introducing odds ratio (OR)-based studies yielded HRs of 4.71 (k = 16) and 4.89 (k = 17).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Funnel plot asymmetry suggested publication bias, with Egger’s test being positive (p = 0.0003). Trim-and-fill imputation adjusted the HR to 3.53, indicating the true effect might be closer to a 3.5-fold risk increase rather than the observed 4.6-fold increase. The review did not find studies that pooled evidence across viral etiologies before this work.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C, making it a credible candidate for layered surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Future research should address publication bias and validate these findings in diverse populations and clinical settings.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the association between elevated serum Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) levels and the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). The review included 23 publications (24 study entries) and found a pooled hazard ratio (HR) of 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I2 = 25.6%). The effect was consistent across etiology and measurement timing. Funnel plot asymmetry suggested publication bias, with an adjusted HR of 3.53 after trim-and-fill imputation. The review concludes that M2BPGi is a strong predictor of HCC development and a credible candidate for layered surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Future research should address publication bias and validate these findings in diverse populations and clinical settings.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 或丙型肝炎 (HCV) 患者血清 Mac-2 结合蛋白糖基化异构体 (M2BPGi) 水平升高与肝细胞癌 (HCC) 发展之间的关系。核心问题是 M2BPGi 是否可以作为这些人群中 HCC 发展的预测因子。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析检索了截至 2026 年 4 月的 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane 图书馆、Web of Science 和 Scopus,以查找报告 HCC 风险比 (HR) 与 CHB 或 HCV 中 M2BPGi 升高相关的纵向研究。该协议已在 PROSPERO 注册。主要样本库包括 15 项报告 HR 的分类截止纵向研究,涵盖 12,161 名参与者和至少 1,189 起 HCC 事件。使用限制最大似然和 Hartung-Knapp 调整的随机效应荟萃分析。[A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11]。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: M2BPGi 升高的患者发生 HCC 的汇总风险比 (HR) 为 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54;p < 0.0001),异质性较低 (I2 = 25.6%)。不同病因(CHB HR 4.12;HCV HR 5.07;p_subgroup = 0.62)和测量时间(基线 HR 3.21;治疗中/治疗后 HR 5.62;SVR 后 HR 5.45;p_subgroup = 0.23)的效果是一致的。重新引入基于比值比 (OR) 的研究的敏感性分析得出的 HR 为 4.71 (k = 16) 和 4.89 (k = 17)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 漏斗图不对称表明存在发表偏倚,Egger 检验呈阳性 (p = 0.0003)。修剪填充插补将 HR 调整为 3.53,表明真实效果可能更接近风险增加 3.5 倍,而不是观察到的 4.6 倍增加。该综述没有发现在这项工作之前汇集了病毒病因学证据的研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 血清 M2BPGi 升高与慢性乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎患者的 HCC 发展密切相关,使其成为分层监测的可靠候选者,特别是病毒学控制后的风险分层。未来的研究应该解决发表偏倚,并在不同人群和临床环境中验证这些发现。

analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies reporting hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in CHB or HCV. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO. The primary pool included 15 longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs reporting HRs, covering 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. Random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment was used. [A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11].
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled hazard ratio (HR) for HCC development in patients with elevated M2BPGi was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I2 = 25.6%). The effect was consistent across etiology (CHB HR 4.12; HCV HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Sensitivity analyses re-introducing odds ratio (OR)-based studies yielded HRs of 4.71 (k = 16) and 4.89 (k = 17).
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Funnel plot asymmetry suggested publication bias, with Egger’s test being positive (p = 0.0003). Trim-and-fill imputation adjusted the HR to 3.53, indicating the true effect might be closer to a 3.5-fold risk increase rather than the observed 4.6-fold increase. The review did not find studies that pooled evidence across viral etiologies before this work.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C, making it a credible candidate for layered surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Future research should address publication bias and validate these findings in diverse populations and clinical settings.

papers.title_zh: 血清 M2BPGi 作为慢性乙型和丙型肝炎肝细胞癌发展的预测因子:系统评价和荟萃分析
papers.source_body_en: Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) kills about 830,000 people each year, and most cases arise in chronic viral hepatitis. Better risk markers would let clinicians focus surveillance where it matters. Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) is a serum glycobiomarker of liver fibrosis. Several cohort studies tie elevated M2BPGi to HCC. No quantitative synthesis has pooled this evidence across viral etiologies. Methods We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies that reported hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). We registered the protocol with PROSPERO. The primary pool restricted to longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs that reported HRs. We used random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment. Results Twenty-three publications (24 study entries) met inclusion criteria. The primary pool of 15 longitudinal categorical HR-reporting studies covered 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. The pooled HR was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I 2 = 25.6%). The 95% prediction interval ran from 2.08 to 10.18. The effect held across etiology (CHB k = 5 HR 4.12; HCV k = 10 HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and across measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Two sensitivity pools re-introducing OR-based studies gave HR 4.71 ( k = 16) and HR 4.89 ( k = 17). Egger’s test was positive ( p = 0.0003); trim-and-fill imputed six studies and pulled the adjusted HR to 3.53. Conclusion Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C. The effect holds across etiology, treatment status, and measurement timing–including after sustained virological response. Funnel asymmetry suggests the true effect is closer to a 3.5-fold than a 4.6-fold risk increase, still large enough to matter clinically. M2BPGi is a credible candidate to layer onto current viral hepatitis surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372566 , identifier CRD420261372566.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 肝细胞癌(HCC)每年导致约830,000人死亡,大多数病例源于慢性病毒性肝炎。更好的风险标志物将使临床医生能够将监测重点放在关键领域。Mac-2结合蛋白糖基化异构体(M2BPGi)是肝纤维化的血清糖生物标志物。多项队列研究将M2BPGi升高与HCC联系起来。尚未有定量合成将这种证据按病毒病因进行汇总。方法 我们通过2026年4月检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane Library、Web of Science和Scopus,查找报告慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)或丙型肝炎(HCV)患者中M2BPGi升高与HCC相关联的比值比(HR)的纵向研究。我们在PROSPERO上注册了方案。主要汇总池仅限于报告HR的具有分类截断值的纵向研究。我们使用限制性最大似然法和Hartung–Knapp调整进行随机效应荟萃分析。结果 23篇出版物(24个研究条目)符合纳入标准。15项主要纵向分类HR报告研究汇总池涵盖了12,161名参与者和至少1,189例HCC事件。汇总HR为4.61(95% CI 3.24–6.54;p < 0.0001),异质性较低(I 2 = 25.6%)。95%预测区间从2.08到10.18。该效应在病因学(CHB k = 5 HR 4.12;HCV k = 10 HR 5.07;p_subgroup = 0.62)和测量时机(基线HR 3.21;治疗中/治疗后HR 5.62;SVR后HR 5.45;p_subgroup = 0.23)上均保持一致。重新纳入基于比值比(OR)研究的两个敏感性汇总池分别得出HR 4.71(k = 16)和HR 4.89(k = 17)。Egger检验呈阳性(p = 0.0003);修剪填充法填补了六项研究,并将调整后的HR拉低至3.53。结论 血清M2BPGi升高与慢性乙型和丙型肝炎患者HCC的发生强且一致相关。该效应在病因学、治疗状态和测量时机上均保持一致——包括在持续病毒学应答之后。漏斗不对称表明真实效应更接近3.5倍而非4.6倍的风险增加,但仍足以在临床上产生影响。M2BPGi是一个可信的候选标志物,可叠加到当前的病毒性肝炎监测中,特别是在病毒学控制后的风险分层方面。系统评价注册 https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372566,标识符CRD420261372566。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 或丙型肝炎 (HCV) 患者血清 Mac-2 结合蛋白糖基化异构体 (M2BPGi) 水平升高与肝细胞癌 (HCC) 发展之间的关系。核心问题是 M2BPGi 是否可以作为这些人群中 HCC 发展的预测因子。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析检索了截至 2026 年 4 月的 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane 图书馆、Web of Science 和 Scopus,以查找报告 HCC 风险比 (HR) 与 CHB 或 HCV 中 M2BPGi 升高相关的纵向研究。该协议已在 PROSPERO 注册。主要样本库包括 15 项报告 HR 的分类截止纵向研究,涵盖 12,161 名参与者和至少 1,189 起 HCC 事件。使用限制最大似然和 Hartung-Knapp 调整的随机效应荟萃分析。[A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11]。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: M2BPGi 升高的患者发生 HCC 的汇总风险比 (HR) 为 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54;p < 0.0001),异质性较低 (I2 = 25.6%)。不同病因(CHB HR 4.12;HCV HR 5.07;p_subgroup = 0.62)和测量时间(基线 HR 3.21;治疗中/治疗后 HR 5.62;SVR 后 HR 5.45;p_subgroup = 0.23)的效果是一致的。重新引入基于比值比 (OR) 的研究的敏感性分析得出的 HR 为 4.71 (k = 16) 和 4.89 (k = 17)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 漏斗图不对称表明存在发表偏倚,Egger 检验呈阳性 (p = 0.0003)。修剪填充插补将 HR 调整为 3.53,表明真实效果可能更接近风险增加 3.5 倍,而不是观察到的 4.6 倍增加。该综述没有发现在这项工作之前汇集了病毒病因学证据的研究。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 血清 M2BPGi 升高与慢性乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎患者的 HCC 发展密切相关,使其成为分层监测的可靠候选者,特别是病毒学控制后的风险分层。未来的研究应该解决发表偏倚,并在不同人群和临床环境中验证这些发现。

papers.title: Recombinant polyclonal antibody GIGA-2339 potently and pan-genotypically neutralizes hepatitis B virus.
papers.abstract: Existing hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatments control viral replication in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients but fail to prevent hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) production; excessive HBsAg production leads to HBV-specific immune tolerance. GIGA-2339 is a first-in-class, recombinant polyclonal antibody (pAb) therapeutic consisting of over 1,000 human IgG1/IgK antibodies targeting HBsAg epitopes developed for the treatment of chronic HBV infection. As Hepatitis D virus (HDV) utilizes HBsAg produced by HBV for viral entry, GIGA-2339 may also provide benefit to HDV/HBV co-infected patients. Memory B cells from HBV vaccinated donors were isolated and HBsAg-specific antibody sequences were enriched using GigaGen's single cell microfluidic antibody capture platform. Full-length antibody sequences targeting HBsAg were cloned and transfected en masse using a targeted integration Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line, followed by bulk expression and purification. In vitro, GIGA-2339 bound HBsAg and neutralized live HBV with over 2,000-fold greater potency than a plasma-based hepatitis B immunoglobulin hyperimmune (HyperHEP B) and slightly lower potency than a HBsAg monoclonal antibody (mAb). GIGA-2339 neutralized pan-genotypic HBsAg (A-H) enveloped viral particles, bound clinically significant HBsAg escape mutants, and engaged human Fc receptors on immune cells. In vivo studies showed improved reduction of circulating HBsAg in a chronic stage as compared to HyperHEP B. The novel polyclonal antibody therapeutic GIGA-2339 potently binds and neutralizes HBsAg to prevent viral infection and to reduce circulating antigen. GIGA-2339 represents an important new therapeutic modality for the CHB treatment landscape and is currently in clinical development.

papers.title_zh: 重组多克隆抗体 GIGA-2339 可有效、全基因型中和乙型肝炎病毒。
papers.source_body_en: Existing hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatments control viral replication in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients but fail to prevent hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) production; excessive HBsAg production leads to HBV-specific immune tolerance. GIGA-2339 is a first-in-class, recombinant polyclonal antibody (pAb) therapeutic consisting of over 1,000 human IgG1/IgK antibodies targeting HBsAg epitopes developed for the treatment of chronic HBV infection. As Hepatitis D virus (HDV) utilizes HBsAg produced by HBV for viral entry, GIGA-2339 may also provide benefit to HDV/HBV co-infected patients. Memory B cells from HBV vaccinated donors were isolated and HBsAg-specific antibody sequences were enriched using GigaGen's single cell microfluidic antibody capture platform. Full-length antibody sequences targeting HBsAg were cloned and transfected en masse using a targeted integration Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line, followed by bulk expression and purification. In vitro, GIGA-2339 bound HBsAg and neutralized live HBV with over 2,000-fold greater potency than a plasma-based hepatitis B immunoglobulin hyperimmune (HyperHEP B) and slightly lower potency than a HBsAg monoclonal antibody (mAb). GIGA-2339 neutralized pan-genotypic HBsAg (A-H) enveloped viral particles, bound clinically significant HBsAg escape mutants, and engaged human Fc receptors on immune cells. In vivo studies showed improved reduction of circulating HBsAg in a chronic stage as compared to HyperHEP B. The novel polyclonal antibody therapeutic GIGA-2339 potently binds and neutralizes HBsAg to prevent viral infection and to reduce circulating antigen. GIGA-2339 represents an important new therapeutic modality for the CHB treatment landscape and is currently in clinical development.

papers.title: Correlates of hepatitis B virus awareness and disease specific knowledge in Uganda: a meta-analysis and meta-regression of studies published between 2018 and 2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda despite national vaccination and screening initiatives, and understanding awareness and disease-specific knowledge levels is essential for guiding prevention and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study synthesized cross-sectional evidence on HBV awareness and disease-specific knowledge in Uganda through a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between January 2018 and December 2025.
analysis.methods: Two reviewers independently selected studies, extracted data, and appraised quality using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies, with pooled estimates computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software and heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic.
analysis.main_results: The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%), and awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda and among healthcare workers compared to other regions and groups.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified critical gaps in HBV awareness and specific knowledge domains, including low awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and transmission through infected body fluids, and highlighted a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for targeted, regionally tailored health communication strategies to address persistent knowledge gaps and declining awareness trends in HBV prevention and control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The substantial heterogeneity (I2=99.24%) and the observed decline in awareness over time limit the strength of the evidence, despite rigorous systematic review methods and subgroup analyses.

analysis.summary_en: This meta-analysis synthesized 18 cross-sectional studies published between 2018 and 2025 to assess correlates of hepatitis B virus (HBV) awareness and disease-specific knowledge in Uganda. The pooled HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial regional and population heterogeneity (I2=99.24%). Awareness was higher in Central Uganda and among healthcare workers, but knowledge gaps persisted in key areas such as post-exposure prophylaxis and transmission through infected body fluids. Notably, meta-regression revealed a paradoxical decline in HBV awareness over the study period. The study highlights the urgent need for tailored, region-specific health communication strategies to address these gaps and reverse the declining awareness trend.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有国家疫苗接种和筛查举措,乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,了解意识和特定疾病的知识水平对于指导预防和控制策略至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究通过对 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的研究进行系统回顾和荟萃分析,综合了乌干达 HBV 认识和特定疾病知识的横断面证据。
elements_zh.methods: 两名评审员独立选择研究、提取数据并使用 Joanna Briggs Institute 分析横断面研究关键评估清单评估质量,并使用 MedCalc 软件中的随机效应模型计算汇总估计值,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。
elements_zh.main_results: 乙型肝炎知晓率汇总为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%),乌干达中部和医护人员的知晓率明显高于其他地区和群体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现了乙型肝炎意识和特定知识领域的关键差距,包括对暴露后预防和通过受感染体液传播的意识较低,并强调了研究期间乙型肝炎意识的整体下降。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要制定有针对性的、针对区域的健康传播战略,以解决乙型肝炎预防和控制方面持续存在的知识差距和意识下降的趋势。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管有严格的系统评价方法和亚组分析,但显着的异质性(I2=99.24%)和观察到的意识随着时间的推移而下降限制了证据的强度。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,尽管国家采取了疫苗接种和筛查举措,但其患病率因地区和人群而异。了解意识和知识水平对于指导乙肝预防和控制策略至关重要。这项研究综合了乌干达不同人群对乙肝病毒的认识和疾病具体知识之间的相关性的现有证据。方法:我们系统地检索了 PubMed、非洲期刊在线 (AJOL) 和 Google Scholar,查找 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的关于乌干达 HBV 认知或特定疾病知识的横断面研究。研究选择、数据提取和质量评估由两名评审员使用 Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) 分析横断面研究批判评估清单独立进行。最终综合报告中纳入了十八项符合资格标准的研究。使用 MedCalc 软件(版本 10.10)中的随机效应模型计算 HBV 认知度和特定疾病知识相关性的汇总估计,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。通过亚组分析和敏感性分析探讨异质性的来源。进行元回归以检查按地区、出版年份和研究人群划分的 HBV 认知趋势。使用 Begg 和 Egger 测试评估发表偏倚。统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05,所有估计值均以 95% 置信区间报告。结果:十八项研究符合纳入标准。乙型肝炎知晓率汇总率为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群之间存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%)。亚组分析显示,与北部、东部和西部地区相比,乌干达中部地区的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05),与一般人群和产前护理人员相比,医护人员的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05)。对特定 HBV 领域的了解差异很大:与先前没有 HBV 知识的参与者相比,知识丰富的参与者对病原体、筛查服务和疫苗接种可用性的认识显着较高 (p < 0.05),而与至少接受部分疫苗接种的参与者相比,对暴露后预防和完成完整 HBV 疫苗接种计划的认识仍然较低 (p < 0.05)。尽管对通过受感染体液传播的了解仍然很少,但对性接触、共用针头和母婴传播等关键传播途径的了解程度较低。与教育水平较低的参与者相比,受教育程度较高的参与者更有可能接种疫苗(p < 0.05),对疫苗有效性持积极态度的参与者比持消极态度的参与者更有可能接种疫苗(p < 0.05)。荟萃回归分析进一步揭示了研究期间乙肝病毒认知度整体下降的矛盾现象。结论:对乙肝病毒的认识和关键知识领域仍然存在严重差距,这突出表明在传播健康信息时需要针对当代社会动态制定替代策略。临床试验编号:不适用。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有国家疫苗接种和筛查举措,乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,了解意识和特定疾病的知识水平对于指导预防和控制策略至关重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究通过对 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的研究进行系统回顾和荟萃分析,综合了乌干达 HBV 认识和特定疾病知识的横断面证据。
analysis_zh.methods: 两名评审员独立选择研究、提取数据并使用 Joanna Briggs Institute 分析横断面研究关键评估清单评估质量,并使用 MedCalc 软件中的随机效应模型计算汇总估计值,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 乙型肝炎知晓率汇总为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%),乌干达中部和医护人员的知晓率明显高于其他地区和群体。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现了乙型肝炎意识和特定知识领域的关键差距,包括对暴露后预防和通过受感染体液传播的意识较低,并强调了研究期间乙型肝炎意识的整体下降。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要制定有针对性的、针对区域的健康传播战略,以解决乙型肝炎预防和控制方面持续存在的知识差距和意识下降的趋势。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管有严格的系统评价方法和亚组分析,但显着的异质性(I2=99.24%)和观察到的意识随着时间的推移而下降限制了证据的强度。

papers.title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

papers.title: Drug resistance mutations of hepatitis B virus (HBV) influence the yield of the virions of the human hepatitis delta virus (HDV) and their infectivity
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: This work analyzed 30 drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBV) (i.e., HBsAg) selected by several FDA-approved anti-HBV nucleos(t)ide analogs. All DRM-bearing HBsAg variants supported the formation and secretion of hepatitis delta virus (HDV), and only 13/30 DRMs considerably decreased the yield of secreted HDV virions. However, the majority of DRMs (23/30) greatly reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them even caused the complete loss of infectivity, which was determined by analyzing the levels of HDV RNA genomes in the infected cells, and the fraction of HDV-infected cells. The ability to inhibit HDV infectivity was observed for DRMs located in the large cytosolic loop (LCL), major antigenic loop (MAL), HDV-binding site (HDV-BS), and the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg, which suggested that DRMs mediate their inhibitory influence by both direct and indirect mechanisms that could alter the attachment/entry, post-entry trafficking, and/or subsequent uncoating of the virions. This report also established the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV as critical regulators of the overall infectivity of HDV virions. It became apparent that in the settings of natural HBV/HDV infection, DRMs can therefore greatly reduce the spread/superinfection of HDV and diminish the size of the HDV reservoir in chronically infected livers. Overall, our findings advanced the understanding of how anti-HBV drug treatments influence the HDV life cycle, the roles of HBV envelope proteins in facilitating the assembly and infectivity of HDV, and the mechanism of complex HBV-HDV interactions. IMPORTANCE: The study showed that the drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBsAg) can greatly reduce hepatitis delta virus (HDV) assembly and infectivity. Since most of the tested DRMs considerably reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them resulted in a complete loss of the infectivity, such effects can lead to suppression of HDV spread/superinfection and reduction of the HDV reservoir in the infected liver. If most detrimental for infectivity DRMs are present on the majority of HBsAg molecules, this could facilitate substantial suppression of chronic HDV infection and possibly reduce HDV-associated liver pathogenesis. It was also determined that DRMs located in the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg could critically alter HDV infectivity. Our findings therefore suggest that different HBsAg regions work in the intramolecular coordinating concert, facilitating the assembly and infectivity of the virions, and that certain short- and long-distance interactions between different regions of HBsAg take place.

source_records.title: Drug resistance mutations of hepatitis B virus (HBV) influence the yield of the virions of the human hepatitis delta virus (HDV) and their infectivity.
source_records.abstract: This work analyzed 30 drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBV) (i.e., HBsAg) selected by several FDA-approved anti-HBV nucleos(t)ide analogs. papers.title: Evaluating the impact of the Hepatitis B Foundation's international storytelling program on empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health challenge, characterized by low awareness, underdiagnosis, limited access to care, and persistent stigma. Storytelling has emerged as a promising health communication strategy to humanize disease experiences, reduce stigma, and promote advocacy. This study evaluates the Hepatitis B Foundation's International Storytelling Program and its impact on storytellers' empowerment, confidence, stigma experiences, and advocacy engagement. METHODS: A mixed-methods evaluation was conducted among adults who recorded personal hepatitis B stories through the program. Quantitative data were collected via an immediate post-recording survey (n = 25) and a follow-up survey 3-6 months later (n = 11), assessing satisfaction, emotional responses, confidence, stigma experiences, and advocacy activities. Survey instruments were developed by the study team and were not previously validated, which may limit measurement reliability and comparability across studies. Descriptive statistics were calculated. Fifteen participants were interviewed qualitatively; these individuals were part of an eligible pool of storytellers spanning 22 countries. Interviews were transcribed and analyzed using qualitative content analysis with double coding to support coding consistency. Quantitative and qualitative findings were integrated to provide a comprehensive understanding of program impacts. RESULTS: Participants reported high satisfaction and immediate personal benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived preparedness to advocate (96%). At follow-up, participants reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B (73%) and personal growth (73%), although findings should be interpreted cautiously due to the small sample size. Qualitative findings suggest that storytelling supported emotional processing, identity reframing, and increased willingness to disclose, while also contributing to perceived community awareness and engagement. CONCLUSIONS: The International Storytelling Program is a practical, promising approach for empowering individuals affected by hepatitis B and promoting advocacy and stigma reduction globally. However, results should be interpreted cautiously due to sample size and potential selection bias. Storytelling may serve as a complementary strategy to traditional public health approaches. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Not applicable.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其特点是认识低、诊断不足、获得护理的机会有限和持续存在耻辱。讲故事已成为一种很有前途的健康传播策略,可以使疾病体验人性化、减少耻辱并促进宣传。本研究评估了乙型肝炎基金会的国际讲故事计划及其对讲故事者的赋权、信心、耻辱经历和倡导参与的影响。方法:对通过该计划记录个人乙型肝炎故事的成年人进行了混合方法评估。通过立即进行录音后调查 (n = 25) 和 3-6 个月后的跟踪调查 (n = 11) 收集定量数据,评估满意度、情绪反应、信心、耻辱经历和宣传活动。调查工具是由研究团队开发的,之前未经验证,这可能会限制研究之间的测量可靠性和可比性。计算描述性统计数据。十五名参与者接受了定性访谈;这些人属于跨越 22 个国家的合格讲故事者群体的一部分。使用定性内容分析和双重编码来转录和分析访谈,以支持编码一致性。定量和定性研究结果相结合,以提供对计划影响的全面了解。结果:参与者报告了高满意度和直接的个人利益,包括信心增强 (92%) 和感知的倡导准备度 (96%)。在随访中,参与者报告说,讨论乙型肝炎 (73%) 和个人成长 (73%) 的舒适度有所提高,但由于样本量较小,应谨慎解释研究结果。定性研究结果表明,讲故事支持情感处理、身份重构和增加披露意愿,同时也有助于提高社区意识和参与度。结论:国际讲故事计划是一种实用且有前途的方法,可以增强乙型肝炎患者的权能,并在全球范围内促进宣传和减少耻辱。然而,由于样本量和潜在的选择偏差,应谨慎解释结果。讲故事可以作为传统公共卫生方法的补充策略。试用注册:不适用。

papers.title: Hypovitaminosis D-Induced Secondary Hyperparathyroidism With Concomitant Femoral Fracture in a Chronic Hepatitis B Patient: A Case Report.
papers.abstract: Vitamin D deficiency and secondary hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) are preventable causes of metabolic bone disease, yet they may remain clinically silent until catastrophic skeletal events occur. Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection has been increasingly linked to disordered bone and mineral metabolism, even in the absence of cirrhosis. We report a 39-year-old man with chronic HBV infection who presented with a low-trauma subtrochanteric femoral fracture. He had no history of alcohol or tobacco use and had only recently commenced antiviral therapy. Biochemical evaluation revealed severe vitamin D deficiency, markedly elevated parathyroid hormone levels, hypophosphatemia, and raised alkaline phosphatase, consistent with SHPT and metabolic bone disease. There was no clinical or radiological evidence of liver cirrhosis. The patient underwent surgical fixation of the fracture, received vitamin D supplementation, and was initiated on Tenofovir Alafenamide, with good clinical recovery.

papers.title: Prevalence and Serological Profile of Occult Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Newly Diagnosed Cancer Patients.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Occult hepatitis B virus infection (OBI) represents a diagnostic and clinical challenge, particularly among cancer patients who are at risk of viral reactivation during immunosuppressive therapy. Limited data are available from India on the prevalence and characteristics of OBI in malignancy. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and describe the serological profile of OBI among newly diagnosed cancer patients at a tertiary care hospital. MATERIALS & METHODS A cross-sectional study was conducted in 2023, including 100 newly diagnosed cancer patients prior to chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Serum samples negative for Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) were screened for HBV DNA using quantitative real-time PCR. Serological testing for IgM anti-HBc, Total anti-HBc and anti-HBs antibodies was performed on OBI-positive cases. Demographic and clinical variables were analyzed descriptively. RESULTS OBI was detected in 7% (7/100) of patients, with HBV DNA levels ranging from 79 to 64,533 IU/mL (mean: 10,823 IU/mL; median: 519 IU/mL). Among OBI-positive individuals, 42.8% were seropositive (anti-HBc and/or anti-HBs positive) and 57.1% were seronegative. CONCLUSION A 7% prevalence of OBI was observed among treatment-naïve cancer patients, with notably high HBV DNA levels compared to existing data. The presence of OBI in both vaccinated and seronegative individuals highlights the inadequacy of serology-based screening. Incorporating HBV DNA testing into routine pre-chemotherapy and radiation therapy screening is strongly recommended to prevent reactivation and improve safety in cancer management.

papers.title_zh: 新诊断癌症患者隐匿性乙型肝炎病毒感染的患病率和血清学特征。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND Occult hepatitis B virus infection (OBI) represents a diagnostic and clinical challenge, particularly among cancer patients who are at risk of viral reactivation during immunosuppressive therapy. Limited data are available from India on the prevalence and characteristics of OBI in malignancy. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and describe the serological profile of OBI among newly diagnosed cancer patients at a tertiary care hospital. MATERIALS & METHODS A cross-sectional study was conducted in 2023, including 100 newly diagnosed cancer patients prior to chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Serum samples negative for Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) were screened for HBV DNA using quantitative real-time PCR. Serological testing for IgM anti-HBc, Total anti-HBc and anti-HBs antibodies was performed on OBI-positive cases. Demographic and clinical variables were analyzed descriptively. RESULTS OBI was detected in 7% (7/100) of patients, with HBV DNA levels ranging from 79 to 64,533 IU/mL (mean: 10,823 IU/mL; median: 519 IU/mL). Among OBI-positive individuals, 42.8% were seropositive (anti-HBc and/or anti-HBs positive) and 57.1% were seronegative. CONCLUSION A 7% prevalence of OBI was observed among treatment-naïve cancer patients, with notably high HBV DNA levels compared to existing data. The presence of OBI in both vaccinated and seronegative individuals highlights the inadequacy of serology-based screening. Incorporating HBV DNA testing into routine pre-chemotherapy and radiation therapy screening is strongly recommended to prevent reactivation and improve safety in cancer management.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景技术隐匿性乙型肝炎病毒感染(OBI)代表了诊断和临床挑战,特别是在免疫抑制治疗期间面临病毒再激活风险的癌症患者中。印度关于恶性肿瘤中 OBI 的患病率和特征的数据有限。本研究旨在确定三级医院新诊断癌症患者中 OBI 的患病率并描述其血清学特征。材料与方法 2023 年进行了一项横断面研究,包括 100 名化疗或放疗前新诊断的癌症患者。使用定量实时 PCR 对乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 阴性的血清样本进行 HBV DNA 筛查。对 OBI 阳性病例进行 IgM 抗 HBc、总抗 HBc 和抗 HBs 抗体的血清学检测。对人口统计学和临床​​变量进行了描述性分析。结果 7% (7/100) 的患者检测到 OBI,HBV DNA 水平范围为 79 至 64,533 IU/mL(平均值:10,823 IU/mL;中位数:519 IU/mL)。在 OBI 阳性个体中,42.8% 为血清阳性(抗 HBc 和/或抗 HBs 阳性),57.1% 为血清阴性。结论 在初治癌症患者中观察到 OBI 患病率为 7%,与现有数据相比,其 HBV DNA 水平明显较高。OBI 在接种疫苗和血清阴性个体中的存在凸显了基于血清学的筛查的不足。强烈建议将 HBV DNA 检测纳入常规化疗前和放疗筛查中,以防止病毒再激活并提高癌症治疗的安全性。

papers.full_text: Abstract Purpose of Review Long-term nucleos (t)ide analogue (NAs) treatment is usually required to maintain viral suppression in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), with raising concerns on the long-term safety of NA therapy. In this review, we comprehensively summarized the current evidence on the long-term safety of NA therapy, with a particular focus on the first-line NAs (entecavir [ETV], tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], and tenofovir alafenamide [TAF]). Recent Findings The first-line NAs have no (TDF, TAF) or very low (ETV) viral resistance rates in treatment-naïve patients. ETV is associated with birth defects in animal studies. TDF is associated with a small risk renal and bone toxicity, primarily in older and higher risk patients. TAF has favorable renal and bone safety as compared to TDF, while its impact on lipid metabolism warrants attention. Although extremely rare, severe lactic acidosis can occur during NA treatment. Summary Long-term therapy with NAs is generally very safe, with potential risk of birth defects with ETV based on animal studies, potential viral resistance with ETV (rare if treatment-naïve and significant if prior lamivudine exposure/resistance), potential renal and bone mineral density adverse effects with TDF, lipid metabolism dysfunction with TAF, and rare but potentially severe lactic acidosis. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Purpose of Review Long-term nucleos (t)ide analogue (NAs) treatment is usually required to maintain viral suppression in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), with raising concerns on the long-term safety of NA therapy. In this review, we comprehensively summarized the current evidence on the long-term safety of NA therapy, with a particular focus on the first-line NAs (entecavir [ETV], tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], and tenofovir alafenamide [TAF]). Recent Findings The first-line NAs have no (TDF, TAF) or very low (ETV) viral resistance rates in treatment-naïve patients. ETV is associated with birth defects in animal studies. TDF is associated with a small risk renal and bone toxicity, primarily in older and higher risk patients. TAF has favorable renal and bone safety as compared to TDF, while its impact on lipid metabolism warrants attention. Although extremely rare, severe lactic acidosis can occur during NA treatment. Summary Long-term therapy with NAs is generally very safe, with potential risk of birth defects with ETV based on animal studies, potential viral resistance with ETV (rare if treatment-naïve and significant if prior lamivudine exposure/resistance), potential renal and bone mineral density adverse effects with TDF, lipid metabolism dysfunction with TAF, and rare but potentially severe lactic acidosis. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. papers.title: HBcAg-Induced IL-17F drives liver fibrosis in occult HBV infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the mechanistic basis for occult hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (OBI) driving liver fibrosis. papers.title_zh: HBcAg 诱导的 IL-17F 在隐匿性 HBV 感染中导致肝纤维化
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

papers.title: Long-term incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma after hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) decreases following hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance. We examined HCC incidence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who cleared HBsAg compared to general population. METHODS: All adults with CHB who cleared HBsAg between 2000-2022 were identified using a territory-wide database in Hong Kong. Annual HCC incidences were estimated and compared to general population. Age- and sex-specific population statistics were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department. RESULTS: Of 13,379 patients with HBsAg seroclearance (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% males, 14.6% cirrhosis), 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) years. Annual HCC incidence (95% CI) was 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) and 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%) among patients with cirrhosis aged <50 years and ≥50 years at HBsAg seroclearance, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis who cleared HBsAg before age 50, the annual HCC incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%-0.06%), comparable to 0.03% in general population. Annual HCC incidence of male patients without cirrhosis aged <40 and 40-49 years at HBsAg was 0.02% (95% CI 0.002%-0.08%) and 0.09% (0.03%-0.19%), respectively. No HCC cases occurred during 15 years of follow-up among 1,317 female patients without cirrhosis aged <50 years at HBsAg loss; the annual HCC incidence was 0.06% (95% CI 0.02%-0.13%) among those aged 50-59 years. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with CHB who clear HBsAg at younger ages, particularly men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis or additional risk factors, have very low HCC risk and may not require routine surveillance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的主要原因,但乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 血清清除后的长期风险尚不确定。该研究探讨了 HBsAg 血清清除是否会降低 HCC 发病率,并确定了可能不需要监测的患者亚组。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项在香港进行的全港队列研究利用全港数据库确定了 2000 年至 2022 年间所有实现 HBsAg 血清清除的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者。该队列包括 13,379 名患者(平均年龄 59.7±13.7 岁,59.8% 为男性,14.6% 患有肝硬化),并将 HCC 发病率与特定年龄和性别的人口统计数据进行了比较。
elements_zh.methods: 每年估计 HCC 发病率,并按年龄、性别、肝硬化状态和 HBsAg 血清清除时的年龄进行分层。从香港癌症登记处和政府统计处检索特定年龄和性别的人口数据进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 13,379 名患者中,274 名 (2.0%) 患者在中位 5.6 年 (IQR 3.1-9.8) 时发展为 HCC。年龄<50岁和≥50岁的肝硬化患者的HCC年发病率分别为0.43%(95% CI 0.22%–0.73%)和0.62%(95% CI 0.50%–0.76%)。在无肝硬化的患者中,50 岁以下的患者的年发病率为 0.03%(95% CI 0.01%–0.06%),与一般人群相当。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,年轻时的 HBsAg 血清清除率,特别是在 40 岁以下的男性和 50 岁以下且无肝硬化的女性中,与极低的 HCC 风险相关。这对这些亚组中进行常规 HCC 监测的需求提出了挑战,凸显了临床决策的新分层。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,对于年轻时清除 HBsAg 而没有肝硬化的患者,可以安全地推迟 HCC 监测,从而可能减轻医疗负担并提高生活质量。结果支持血清清除后 CHB 管理中的风险分层监测策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计、对全港数据库的依赖以及血清清除前抗病毒治疗数据的缺乏。由于潜在的不可测量的混杂因素和仅限于香港人口的普遍性,证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除后肝细胞癌的长期发病率。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) decreases following hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance. We examined HCC incidence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who cleared HBsAg compared to general population. METHODS: All adults with CHB who cleared HBsAg between 2000-2022 were identified using a territory-wide database in Hong Kong. Annual HCC incidences were estimated and compared to general population. Age- and sex-specific population statistics were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department. RESULTS: Of 13,379 patients with HBsAg seroclearance (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% males, 14.6% cirrhosis), 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) years. Annual HCC incidence (95% CI) was 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) and 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%) among patients with cirrhosis aged <50 years and ≥50 years at HBsAg seroclearance, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis who cleared HBsAg before age 50, the annual HCC incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%-0.06%), comparable to 0.03% in general population. Annual HCC incidence of male patients without cirrhosis aged <40 and 40-49 years at HBsAg was 0.02% (95% CI 0.002%-0.08%) and 0.09% (0.03%-0.19%), respectively. No HCC cases occurred during 15 years of follow-up among 1,317 female patients without cirrhosis aged <50 years at HBsAg loss; the annual HCC incidence was 0.06% (95% CI 0.02%-0.13%) among those aged 50-59 years. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with CHB who clear HBsAg at younger ages, particularly men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis or additional risk factors, have very low HCC risk and may not require routine surveillance.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的:乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)血清清除后,肝细胞癌(HCC)的风险降低。我们比较了清除 HBsAg 的慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者与普通人群的 HCC 发病率。方法:使用香港全港数据库对 2000 年至 2022 年期间清除 HBsAg 的所有慢性乙型肝炎成人进行识别。估算年度 HCC 发病率并与一般人群进行比较。特定年龄和性别的人口统计数据取自香港癌症登记处和政府统计处。结果:在 13,379 名 HBsAg 血清清除患者中(平均年龄 59.7±13.7 岁,59.8% 男性,14.6% 肝硬化),274 名 (2.0%) 患者在中位 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) 岁时发展为 HCC。HBsAg 血清清除时年龄<50 岁和≥50 岁的肝硬化患者的年 HCC 发病率 (95% CI) 分别为 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) 和 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%)。在 50 岁之前清除 HBsAg 的无肝硬化患者中,年 HCC 发病率为 0.03%(95% CI 0.01%-0.06%),与普通人群的 0.03% 相当。HBsAg 检测结果显示,年龄 <40 岁和 40-49 岁的无肝硬化男性患者的 HCC 年发病率分别为 0.02%(95% CI 0.002%-0.08%)和 0.09%(0.03%-0.19%)。对 1,317 名年龄 <50 岁且 HBsAg 消失的无肝硬化女性患者进行 15 年随访期间,没有发生 HCC 病例;50-59岁人群中HCC年发病率为0.06%(95% CI 0.02%-0.13%)。结论:在较年轻时清除 HBsAg 的慢性乙型肝炎患者,特别是没有肝硬化或其他危险因素的 40 岁以下男性和 50 岁以下女性,HCC 风险非常低,可能不需要常规监测。

papers.title: Isolated HBc IgM false reactivity in the absence of acute Hepatitis B: a case report
papers.abstract: Abstract Serological markers and their possible combinations are still used for diagnosis, to distinguish between acute and chronic infection, and to assess therapy efficacy, in association with molecular hepatitis B viremia levels. Isolated HBc IgM seropositivity is a distinctive serological pattern that warrants further investigation. We present a 28-year-old male case with a recent diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, for which in-depth analyses have been carried out. The patient’s laboratory testing showed positivity only for HBc IgM. Therefore, a complete hepatitis B serological panel was performed, confirming the first unexpected result. Hepatitis B viremia was undetectable. The sample was also analyzed using another commercial assay, which yielded a negative HBc IgM result. The presence of heterophile antibodies was suspected; therefore, a heterophilic blocking tube was used. The results after the serum’s treatment confirmed that the initial HBc IgM positivity was a false-positive result, attributed to heterophile antibodies. This case report highlights the importance of clinical and laboratory interpretation of hepatitis B markers for accurate diagnosis.

papers.title_zh: 在没有急性乙型肝炎的情况下孤立的 HBc IgM 假反应:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Serological markers and their possible combinations are still used for diagnosis, to distinguish between acute and chronic infection, and to assess therapy efficacy, in association with molecular hepatitis B viremia levels. Isolated HBc IgM seropositivity is a distinctive serological pattern that warrants further investigation. We present a 28-year-old male case with a recent diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, for which in-depth analyses have been carried out. The patient’s laboratory testing showed positivity only for HBc IgM. Therefore, a complete hepatitis B serological panel was performed, confirming the first unexpected result. Hepatitis B viremia was undetectable. The sample was also analyzed using another commercial assay, which yielded a negative HBc IgM result. The presence of heterophile antibodies was suspected; therefore, a heterophilic blocking tube was used. The results after the serum’s treatment confirmed that the initial HBc IgM positivity was a false-positive result, attributed to heterophile antibodies. This case report highlights the importance of clinical and laboratory interpretation of hepatitis B markers for accurate diagnosis.

papers.title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti‐hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg‐positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. Methods The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg‐positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV‐coinfected and HBV‐monoinfected patients were compared. Results Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV‐monoinfection (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]. HDV‐infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p p n = 4/1030). Consecutively, HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023) of patients. Quantitative HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). Conclusions In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV‐infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV‐directed therapy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection is a neglected public-health problem in Uzbekistan where HBV is endemic, yet disease severity, treatment access and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in HDV-coinfected patients remain poorly documented.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted at the Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV), the national reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan, enrolling all HBsAg-positive patients presenting between June 2023 and May 2024.
analysis.methods: Epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed; HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected patients were compared, and HDV RNA was quantified with association to ALT elevation assessed.
analysis.main_results: Among 1393 patients, HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV monoinfection (73.9% [1030/1393] vs 26.1% [363/1393]); HDV-infected patients were younger (41.9 vs 45.4 years), HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023), and HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > ULN.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity in Uzbekistan, highlighting advanced liver disease at presentation and lack of HDV-directed therapy access as novel findings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings underscore an urgent need for improved HDV screening, HCC surveillance and access to HDV-specific antiviral therapy in Uzbekistan.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The retrospective single-centre design, low HCC detection due to insufficient screening and absence of HDV-directed therapy data limit causal inference and generalisability, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study at Uzbekistan’s national viral hepatitis reference centre assessed 1393 HBsAg-positive patients presenting from June 2023 to May 2024 to compare HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected individuals. HDV coinfection was far more prevalent (73.9%) than HBV monoinfection (26.1%), with HDV-infected patients younger and most showing detectable HDV RNA (78.9%), which was independently associated with elevated ALT. The authors interpret these data as evidence that HDV coinfection predominates and is associated with greater disease severity in Uzbekistan, noting that most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease and lack access to HDV-directed therapy. The study highlights critical gaps in screening and treatment access and calls for strengthened HDV surveillance and care.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在乙型肝炎病毒流行的乌兹别克斯坦,慢性丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 感染是一个被忽视的公共卫生问题,但 HDV 合并感染患者的疾病严重程度、治疗可及性和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患病率仍然缺乏记录。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 乌兹别克斯坦国家病毒性肝炎参考中心病毒学科学研究所 (SRIOV) 进行了一项回顾性队列研究,纳入了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 5 月期间出现的所有 HBsAg 阳性患者。
elements_zh.methods: 收集并分析流行病学、临床和实验室数据;对 HDV 合并感染和 HBV 单一感染的患者进行比较,并对 HDV RNA 进行定量,并与评估的 ALT 升高相关。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 1393 名患者中,HDV 合并感染比 HBV 单一感染更为普遍(73.9% [1030/1393] vs 26.1% [363/1393]);HDV 感染患者较年轻(41.9 岁 vs 45.4 岁),78.9% (812/1023) 的 HDV RNA 可检测到,HDV RNA 与 ALT 升高 > ULN 独立相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,在乌兹别克斯坦,丁型肝炎病毒合并感染的患病率和疾病严重程度超过了乙型肝炎病毒单一感染,这突显了目前出现的晚期肝病和缺乏针对丁型肝炎病毒的治疗方法是新发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调乌兹别克斯坦迫切需要改进丁型肝炎病毒筛查、肝癌监测和获得丁型肝炎病毒特异性抗病毒治疗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 回顾性单中心设计、由于筛查不足和缺乏 HDV 导向治疗数据导致 HCC 检出率低,限制了因果推断和普遍性,需要进行适度的置信度评估。

papers.title: NGS-diagnosed HBV encephalitis with isolated left parietal lobe involvement: a case report.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Viral encephalitis refers to the inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral infection, usually manifested as fever, unconsciousness, seizures, and meningeal irritation symptoms. The non-specific clinical manifestations, combined with incomplete medical history, often lead to missed diagnoses and inappropriate treatments. Case presentation We present a case of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) encephalitis, manifesting as isolated left parietal lobe involvement. The patient is a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier who did not receive antiviral therapy. Upon onset, the main symptoms were unconsciousness, fever, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HBV encephalitis thru next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). After antiviral treatment with entecavir and general symptomatic treatment, the patient’s clinical symptoms disappeared, and a follow-up brain MRI showed that the lesion had almost completely resolved. Conclusions Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by HBV are incredibly uncommon in clinical practice. This case highlights that the clinical manifestations of HBV encephalitis are nonspecific and prone to being missed, while neuroimaging often reveals an isolated lesion. Early application of NGS for accurate pathogen diagnosis is crucial to reduce misdiagnosis.

Case presentation We present a case of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) encephalitis, manifesting as isolated left parietal lobe involvement. The patient is a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier who did not receive antiviral therapy. Upon onset, the main symptoms were unconsciousness, fever, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HBV encephalitis thru next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). After antiviral treatment with entecavir and general symptomatic treatment, the patient’s clinical symptoms disappeared, and a follow-up brain MRI showed that the lesion had almost completely resolved. Conclusions Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by HBV are incredibly uncommon in clinical practice. This case highlights that the clinical manifestations of HBV encephalitis are nonspecific and prone to being missed, while neuroimaging often reveals an isolated lesion. Early application of NGS for accurate pathogen diagnosis is crucial to reduce misdiagnosis.

papers.title: Itaconic acid alleviates acute hepatitis by reprogramming NK cell metabolism with mitochondrial dysfunction
papers.abstract:
Background

Immunometabolism provides critical insights into the pathogenesis and treatment of inflammatory diseases. Itaconic acid (ITA), a key immunomodulatory metabolite derived from the tricarboxylic acid cycle, has been extensively characterized in macrophages; however, its direct effects on NK cells and NK cell-mediated liver pathology remain poorly defined.

Methods

Using SCENITH and Seahorse analyses, we assessed ITA's impact on NK cell metabolism via multi-omics, and investigated its underlying mechanisms. The therapeutic potential was then evaluated in a mouse model of poly (I:C)-induced liver injury.

Results

We show that ITA reprograms NK cell metabolism to suppress their proliferation and killing capacity, simultaneously suppressing oxidative phosphorylation while inducing a compensatory glycolytic shift. Multi-omics integration revealed that this metabolic shift corresponds with the upregulation of glycolytic gene networks and significant mitochondrial impairment, mechanistically linked to the inhibition of succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and the downregulation of the NRF1/TFAM mitochondrial biogenesis pathway. ITA also damages mitochondria and impairs autophagic activity, resulting in accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria in NK cells. All these alterations lead to profound suppression of NK cell proliferation and cytotoxic function. Administration of ITA in mice with poly (I:C) -induced liver injury substantially attenuated hepatic damage and suppressed over-inflammation in the liver. This protective effect was associated with inhibited hepatic infiltration and function of both NK and T cells.

Conclusion

Our findings extend the understanding of the immune regulation and metabolic reprogramming of ITA to NK cells, showing that ITA inhibits SDH activity to down-regulate mitochondrial biogenesis through NRF1/TFAM in NK cells with consequent limitation of cytotoxic function, suggesting the further therapeutic potential of ITA application in NK cells-mediated liver pathologies.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景

免疫代谢为炎症性疾病的发病机制和治疗提供了重要的见解。衣康酸 (ITA) 是一种源自三羧酸循环的关键免疫调节代谢物,已在巨噬细胞中得到广泛表征;然而,其对 NK 细胞和 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理学的直接影响仍不清楚。

方法

使用 SCENITH 和 Seahorse 分析,我们通过多组学评估了 ITA 对 NK 细胞代谢的影响,并研究了其潜在机制。然后在多聚 (I:C) 诱导的肝损伤小鼠模型中评估其治疗潜力。

结果

我们表明,ITA 重新编程 NK 细胞代谢,抑制其增殖和杀伤能力,同时抑制氧化磷酸化,同时诱导补偿性糖酵解转变。多组学整合表明,这种代谢变化与糖酵解基因网络的上调和显着的线粒体损伤相对应,在机制上与琥珀酸脱氢酶(SDH)活性的抑制和 NRF1/TFAM 线粒体生物发生途径的下调有关。ITA 还会损害线粒体并损害自噬活性,导致 NK 细胞中功能失调的线粒体积聚。所有这些改变都会导致 NK 细胞增殖和细胞毒功能受到严重抑制。对患有聚(I:C)诱导的肝损伤的小鼠施用ITA可显着减轻肝损伤并抑制肝脏的过度炎症。这种保护作用与抑制 NK 和 T 细胞的肝脏浸润和功能有关。

结论

我们的研究结果扩展了对 ITA 对 NK 细胞的免疫调节和代谢重编程的理解,表明 ITA 抑制 SDH 活性,通过 NK 细胞中的 NRF1/TFAM 下调线粒体生物合成,从而限制细胞毒功能,这表明 ITA 在 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理中的应用具有进一步的治疗潜力。

papers.title: Supramolecular Self-Assembly of Lycorine with Glycyrrhizic Acid into a Nanodrug for Safe and Sustained Anti-HBV Therapy.
papers.abstract: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains a major challenge, as conventional therapies struggle to eliminate the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and subsequently restore adaptive antiviral immunity. Lycorine (LY), a compound with broad-spectrum antiviral activity, has shown particular promise inhibiting HBsAg secretion. However, its clinical application is severely limited by significant cytotoxicity, the induction of apoptosis, a short half-life, and adverse in vivo effects. To overcome these barriers and enhance its therapeutic potential, we designed a self-assembled nanomedicine (LGN) by co-assembling LY with glycyrrhizic acid, a natural anti-HBV agent. This strategy not only protected LY from premature degradation and enabled its sustained release in the colon but also markedly attenuated LY-induced systemic toxicity. Notably, LGN effectively suppressed HBsAg secretion (IC50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM) with a selectivity index (SI > 93) over two-fold higher than that of LY alone (SI = 39.26). Furthermore, LGN concurrently inhibited HBV DNA replication, pgRNA transcription, and the expression of viral protein HBc and HBx, indicating a multitargeted, host-dependent mechanism distinct from nucleos(t)ide analogs. Treatment with this nanomedicine in the HDI model further demonstrated its therapeutic potential against HBV with apparent safety. Further transcriptomic study confirmed that LGN induces a distinct host transcriptional program that disrupts multiple critical stages of the HBV life cycle including viral entry, covalently closed circular DNA maintenance, gene transcription, and immune evasion. Collectively, these findings provide valuable insights into exploiting natural products like LY for antiviral therapy and underscore the potential of self-assembly technology in improving drug safety and pharmacokinetic profiles.

papers.abstract_zh: 实现慢性乙型肝炎的功能性治愈仍然是一个重大挑战,因为传统疗法难以消除乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)并随后恢复适应性抗病毒免疫。Lycorine (LY) 是一种具有广谱抗病毒活性的化合物,在抑制 HBsAg 分泌方面表现出特别的前景。然而,其临床应用因显着的细胞毒性、诱导细胞凋亡、半衰期短和体内不良反应而受到严重限制。为了克服这些障碍并增强其治疗潜力,我们通过将 LY 与天然抗 HBV 药物甘草酸共组装来设计了一种自组装纳米药物 (LGN)。这种策略不仅可以保护 LY 免于过早降解并使其能够在结肠中持续释放,而且还可以显着减弱 LY 引起的全身毒性。值得注意的是,LGN 有效抑制 HBsAg 分泌 (IC50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM),其选择性指数 (SI > 93) 比单独 LY (SI = 39.26) 高出两倍多。此外,LGN 同时抑制 HBV DNA 复制、pgRNA 转录以及病毒蛋白 HBc 和 HBx 的表达,表明与核苷(酸)类似物不同的多靶点、宿主依赖性机制。在 HDI 模型中使用这种纳米药物进行治疗进一步证明了其针对 HBV 的治疗潜力且具有明显的安全性。进一步的转录组学研究证实,LGN 诱导独特的宿主转录程序,破坏 HBV 生命周期的多个关键阶段,包括病毒进入、共价闭合环状 DNA 维持、基因转录和免疫逃避。总的来说,这些发现为利用 LY 等天然产物进行抗病毒治疗提供了宝贵的见解,并强调了自组装技术在改善药物安全性和药代动力学特征方面的潜力。

papers.title: B/F/TAF in people with both HIV-1 and hepatitis B: outcomes from the ALLIANCE open-label extension phase.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).
